steps.title: Connect Studio to Unify
steps.detail: Restart Studio and open your place. Open Plugins > DSH > DSHBridge, type the pairing code from the Roblox toolpack card (all of it if it shows CODE:PORT), and allow HTTP requests to 127.0.0.1 when Studio asks. The first playtest asks once more; allow that too.

steps.title: Add an Open Cloud key (optional)
steps.detail: Only needed for uploads, game passes and developer products. Create a key under Open Cloud > API Keys with Assets, Game passes and Developer products read/write, then ask an agent to run roblox_cloud_config to see where to save it. Never paste the key into a chat.
